item.description: Washington, D.C., and Virginia have sued to block the Executive’s planned 250ft triumphal arch near Arlington National Cemetery, arguing it lacks congressional authorization and would disrupt traffic and emergency services. Construction could begin next week, if not blocked.

item.description: A Turkish soldier, Yusuf Sait Ünlü, was shot and killed while investigating an attempted illegal border crossing near Iran on Saturday, Turkey’s Defense Ministry says. Authorities have not yet identified who fired the shots.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

item.description:
Jordan’s Army has deleted a statement claiming 14 armed men tried to cross from Syria.
Syrian sources say Jordanian guards instead fired toward children playing near the border.
No casualties were reported. Jordan has not explained further.
